tldr.title: In short · The MKR Camp
facts: 1, 2 or 3 weeks, 4 sessions per year. 15 Wrestling spots + 15 MMA spots per session, exclusive choice at application.
Wrestling in Dagestan (Makhachkala, Kaspiysk) or MMA in Chechnya (Grozny). Combining both is only possible in Custom format.
All-inclusive: Russian visa, domestic flight from Istanbul, transfers, housing, 2 meals and 2 training sessions per day. You cover: your flight to Istanbul and travel insurance.
Selective entry: minimum 1 year of practice and a real ground game base. MMA: Advanced level (5+ years). Kids 8-17 with a participating parent via the Family track.
Free online application, selection video call with Ruslan Mukhtarov, no payment before validation.

philosophie.label: PHILOSOPHY
philosophie.title: WHY THE CAUCASUS
philosophie.p1: The best fighters on the planet come from the same place. The Caucasus produces more Olympic wrestling medals per capita than any other region in the world, and its gyms feed the global MMA elite year after year. Here, fighting is passed down from father to son, and has been for centuries.
philosophie.p2: These gyms do not take walk-ins. You get in through invitation, trust and network. That is exactly what MKR opens for you: you train in the real gyms, at the local level of demand, with a setup that lets you get the most out of it from day one.

card_immersion.title: TOTAL IMMERSION
card_immersion.body: For 1 to 3 weeks, you live, eat and train with local athletes. Not a gym rented for tourists: the real sessions, at the local pace.

card_heritage.title: CAUCASUS HERITAGE
card_heritage.body: In Dagestan, wrestling is an identity: every village has its champions. In Grozny, professional structures shape the next generation of world MMA.

fit.label: SELECTION
fit.title: IS THIS CAMP FOR YOU?
for_items: You have at least 1 year of practice in wrestling, grappling, BJJ, judo or MMA, with a real ground game base.
You want the local level of demand: 2 sessions a day, daily sparring, no watered-down version.
You accept simple comfort: camp lodging, local food, unreliable wifi.
You are ready to get dominated the first days and come back the next morning.
not_items: You have never set foot on a mat: build one year of basics in a club first.
You want MMA in Chechnya without an Advanced level: start with the Wrestling camp in Dagestan.
You are looking for a fitness holiday with spa, room service and one class a day.
You want to visit Russia: this camp is a progression tool, not a tourist trip.
fit.note: Selection is not a marketing line: every application goes through a video call with Ruslan Mukhtarov before validation. That is what guarantees the level of the group, your safety and the quality of the experience for everyone.

items.question: Is it dangerous to train in the Caucasus in 2026?
items.answer: Straight answer: the UK FCDO advises against travel to Dagestan and Chechnya, and most Western governments advise against travel to Russia. That is the official frame, and you should know it before applying. The reality our athletes live: stable training cities, strong hospitality towards foreign athletes, and a full MKR protocol: local liaisons with you at all times, urban areas only, pre-departure briefing, 24/7 emergency contact and mandatory repatriation insurance. You leave informed and supported, never alone.

items.question: Who takes care of the Russian visa?
items.answer: MKR handles your application end to end: invitation letter, questionnaire, consular fees included in the package. Depending on your camp duration, the e-visa or classic visa route is chosen for you. Just make sure your passport is valid 6 months after your return, and apply ideally 60 to 90 days before departure. Under 30 days, an express processing surcharge applies.

items.question: I speak neither Russian nor the local languages: how do I follow training?
items.answer: Instruction in the Caucasus works by demonstration: coaches show, you repeat, they correct. On top of that, MKR liaisons are with you in the gym and at the camp to translate what needs translating, from technical briefings to meals. Language has never stopped a participant from progressing.

items.question: Can I just organise this myself, without a camp?
items.answer: Realistically, no. Gyms in Dagestan and Chechnya do not take walk-ins: you get in through an invitation from a coach or a trusted member of the network. Without structure you end up with no gym, no proper lodging and no sports visa. MKR access is built on the personal network of Ruslan Mukhtarov, Chechen, born in Dagestan, former member of the French Olympic wrestling team.

items.question: What level do I need to be accepted?
items.answer: Minimum 1 year of regular practice and a real ground game base (wrestling, grappling, BJJ, judo or MMA). For the MMA camp in Chechnya, Advanced level is required: 5+ years of practice or competition experience, because your sparring partners are professionals. Your level is confirmed on the video call with Ruslan before any validation.

items.question: When do I pay?
items.answer: Never at application. You apply for free, you take the selection video call, and only after validation do you pay your package by bank transfer. Cancellation terms are tiered and written in plain terms in the T&C: more than 60 days before departure, full refund.
